name: Rendering-Invariant State Predictor (RISP)
definition: A network N_θ that takes an image I as input and outputs a state prediction ŝ = N_θ(I), designed to be invariant to rendering parameters ψ, effectively acting as an inverse renderer R⁻¹.
summary: RISP is a neural network that predicts physical states from images while ignoring rendering variations, enabling robust optimization across different visual domains.
